The thirteenth is the number-plate off the sea stack, and it does not count - there are twelve readable plates in this field and the thirteenth is one you make.

steps.comment: Ott has to have finished the steam ladder before any of her later pages can fire; two_hundred walks that, so set the last rung here. Switch 70 is the other half of it: the three pages this file exercises are appended below both of Ott's beat chains, so each of them requires the switch the flying chain sets last. Without it, reading the field would delete the chains instead of following them - which is the lockout this condition exists to prevent, and two_hundred is where the chain itself is walked.

and afterwards she has a page of her own, so the speech happens once
